key.decision_why: The author is answering a triager's screenshot request on a PR with no assigned reviewer, so the triager needs a short note on whether the screenshot ask is met; the PR's code and approach did not change.
key.action_why: The next day laurynmm asked the authors to put the before/after screenshots in tables per the guidelines, with descriptions above each, and kept "not ready" until that was done.
changed: The author says the PR was updated, but there was no new push; only the description changed.
The description now labels each of the three tests with separate Before and After screenshot groups.
still_missing: The before/after screenshots are still stacked in a list, not shown side by side in tables as the visual-changes guidelines recommend.
Each test still lacks a clear heading saying what scenario is being shown, so the screenshots remain hard to follow.
Test 2's After screenshots show the bug is not fixed: the muted message still shows "Show more", and clicking it leaves the message hidden.
The commit summary "Change collapsed messages for muted users" does not follow the commit-discipline format, which needs an area prefix and a period.
key.reply_ask: Thank them, then ask them to put the before/after screenshots side by side in tables, one per test, with a short description of each scenario above it, so review can start.

must_have.fact: Says there was no new code push since the feedback; only the PR description was edited.
Says the screenshots are still not presented as precise side-by-side before/after comparisons (for example tables) per the guidelines, so the ask is only partly met.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and asking for clearer screenshot formatting rather than handing off to a reviewer.
Notes that the author's own Test 2 shows a muted user's collapsed message still displays "Show more", which the issue says should look like any other muted message.
Mentions that the commit summary does not follow Zulip's commit-discipline format.
